text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — SolaceHealth renewal is up Feb 28. They're asking to shorten to 9 months (from 12) and want to route via PO + ACH fallback. Need pricing sign-off + procurement path.
Liam O'Neill: Do we have recommended proration for 9mo? Sales suggested a 10% term discount but I need finance approval.
Jordan Patel: Procurement says they need our vendor code on the PO, and legal wants the bill-to entity confirmed before DocuSign.
Priya Singh: Legal note — if they sign a PO that references a different entity, we need an entity swap SOW. For net30 w/ PO we require PO on file before start date.
Maya Chen: Understood. Can CS deliver the usage baseline + billing contact today so procurement has what they need? I'll ping the customer.
Liam O'Neill: Yep. Quick proration calc I used earlier:
```
12mo list price = $120k
9mo pro rata = 120k * (9/12) = $90k
Apply 10% discount -> $81k total
Effective monthly = $9k
```
Maya Chen: Sending the usage export and the contract contact now. Also confirming they want DocuSign after PO.
invoice-bot: PO received from SolaceHealth (PO# SH-4432) at 1777770200. Attachment: /invoices/SH-4432.pdf :paperclip:
Jordan Patel: Nice — can someone add our vendor code 900-RED to the PO before routing? Procurement flagged missing vendor code as reject reason.
Priya Singh: If procurement attaches that PO to the DocuSign envelope we'll need a clause to reference the amended term (9mo) — I'll draft a short addendum and share.
Liam O'Neill: FYI for finance: I'll queue this as a term-change request. @Priya — once addendum draft is up, I'll nudge finance for the 10% approval.
Maya Chen: I'll run enablement checklist for onboarding assuming 9mo. Can we keep the same onboarding kickoff date if they sign by 2/24?
Jordan Patel: Yes, operations can hold the slot for 2/27 but we need PO + signed addendum by 2/24 EOD to lock it.
Priya Singh: Draft posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/addenda/solace-9mo — please review, I included the billing entity language.
Liam O'Neill: Reviewing now. If approved, I'll update the quote and send to customer with DocuSign link.
Maya Chen: Great — I'm on customer follow-up. Will report back when DocuSign sent. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: (follow-up) Customer confirmed procurement will attach PO after we add vendor code. Waiting on legal addendum signature.
invoice-bot: DocuSign envelope created 1777770360 (Envelope ID: 0f8a3c).
Maya Chen: Thanks — closing the loop here. I'll post a final status update once signed. :white_check_mark:
